decisions.thought: Glimmora is the best lead with Focus Sash to set hazards and pressure. Annihilape's Defiant punishes Incineroar Intimidate and beats Kingambit/Incineroar. Dragonite with Multiscale and Dragon Dance is a strong late-game win-con into this bulky-ish opponent core.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
We need to pick 3 of our 6. Opponent has Garchomp, Gholdengo, Incineroar, Primarina, Dragonite, Kingambit. We need a good core. Glimmora lead for hazards/sash, Gholdengo for special offense, Annihilape as bulky win-con, or Dragonite. 

Opponent has Incineroar (Intimidate), Primarina (Fairy), Kingambit, Dragonite, Garchomp, Gholdengo. Our Annihilape with Defiant is great vs Intimidate. Gholdengo handles Fairy/Primarina? Actually Primarina threatens with Moonblast. 

Let me pick Glimmora lead, Annihilape, Gholdengo. Glimmora sets hazards, sash. Annihilape beats Incineroar/Kingambit. Gholdengo checks Primarina with Make It Rain? Gholdengo is Steel/Ghost, weak to Fire/Ground/Ghost/Dark. Hmm.

Alternatively Dragonite with Multiscale + DD is a strong win-con. 

I'll go Glimmora, Annihilape, Dragonite. Actually Annihilape's Defiant punishes Incineroar's Intimidate. Glimmora sets hazards. Dragonite as late-game sweeper with Multiscale.

Let me commit: BRING: glimmora, annihilape, dragonite.
